reason: A read-only DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin that monitors token consumption through per-session indicators and aggregated daily and per-model usage panels sourced from session data.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中以会话胶囊和全局面板展示输入、输出、上下文及按日期和模型汇总的 Token 用量。
summaries.en: Displays input, output, context, daily, and per-model token usage in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI through a session badge and global statistics panel.

capabilities: Scans local session logs under DSH_HOME/sessions
Aggregates usage by date and model
Exposes a local token-statistics API endpoint
Displays per-session and global usage panels in the web interface
